datasets.name: Bijie Dataset
datasets.verbatim: Bijie Dataset [17]: The dataset consists of 770 samples from Bijie County, Guizhou Province, China; each sample ... includes a satellite optical image, a label image, and a digital elevation model (DEM) from TripleSat, covering rock falls, rock slides, and debris slides. ... [17] S. Ji, D. Yu, C. Shen, W. Li, and Q. Xu, “Landslide detection from an open satellite imagery and digital elevation model dataset using attention boosted convolutional neural networks,” Landslides, vol. 17, no. 6, pp. 1337–1352, Jun. 2020

datasets.name: Landslide4Sense Dataset
datasets.verbatim: Landslide4Sense Dataset [4]: This dataset contains 3799 image patches (128 × 128 pixels, 10-m resolution) integrating Sentinel-2’s 12 spectral bands and topographical layers (DEM and slope) generated from ALOS PALSAR... [4] O. Ghorbanzadeh, Y. Xu, P. Ghamisi, M. Kopp, and D. Kreil, “Landslide4Sense: Reference benchmark data and deep learning models for landslide detection,” IEEE Trans. Geosci. Remote Sens., vol. 60, 2022, Art. no. 5633017, doi: 10.1109/TGRS.2022.3215209.

datasets.name: GF-1 satellite imagery
datasets.verbatim: We applied our model to a subimage from the GF-1 satellite, captured on February 3, 2023, featuring a resolution of 2 m and dimensions of 2053 × 3045 pixels.

methods.name: Optimized landslide semantic segmentation network
methods.summary: A deep learning network for landslide segmentation that utilizes a MobileNetV2 backbone, a multiresolution fusion module (MRFM) to extract and integrate features from coarse to fine details, and a selective kernel attention module (SKAM) to optimize fused information using varied receptive fields.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are mentioned but not linked, and the custom code for the segmentation network is not available.
